title: Civil Maintenance of GI trestle tower, store room etc at Thottapally Lighthouse, Thottapally Harbour
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations (percentage rate) for civil maintenance of the 12 m GI trestle tower, store room etc. at Thottappally Lighthouse, Thottappally Harbour, Kerala - jungle clearing, steel replacement, epoxy painting of tower, wall painting, roof tile repairs and greasing (Kochi Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Thottappally Lighthouse, Thottappally Harbour
sites.work: Civil maintenance of 12 m GI trestle tower, store room etc.

scope.item: Clearing jungle incl. uprooting rank vegetation, grass, brush wood, trees and saplings of girth up to 30 cm and removal of rubbish up to 50 m
Dismantling steel work in built up sections (angles, tees, flats, channels) incl. gusset plates, bolts, nuts, cutting rivets, welding, stacking within 50 m
Structural steel work riveted, bolted or welded in built up sections, trusses and framed work incl. cutting, hoisting, fixing and priming coat
Painting previously painted 12 m high GI trestle tower with epoxy paint (two or more coats) incl. priming, surface preparation, rust removal, scaffolding
Wall painting two coats acrylic emulsion exterior grade (VOC < 50 g/l)
Providing & fixing on roof pressed clay tile (Mangalore tile) 20 mm on steel frame work
Providing & laying on roof pressed clay tile ridge (Mangalore tile) 20 mm on steel frame work
Greasing trestle tower bolts and nuts after cleaning and rust removal, covering with tarpaulin

money.performance_security: 5% of quoted amount, DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; released after completion
money.notes: Estimate is the schedule total (rates include cost index 24.3%): items Rs 4,244.07; 554.81; 38,223.21; 53,335.86; 28,190.10; 538.77; 542.01; 3,326.24 = Rs 1,28,955.06. Percentage rate (below/above) inclusive of GST, materials, labour, transport, scaffolding. No EMD mentioned. Payment on measured actual quantities; no escalation.

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order

eligibility: Contractor to submit PAN card, GST registration and bank account details for payment
Company bidders to name the company as contractor with authorization letter
specs: 12 m high GI trestle tower: epoxy paint finish (two or more coats) over metal primer
Exterior acrylic emulsion paint VOC less than 50 g/litre
Mangalore pressed clay roof tiles and ridge, 20 mm
notes: Submission deadline inconsistent: page 1 Hindi says 26.02.2026 17:00 and English 26.02.2026 15:00; Terms & Conditions clause 2 says 25.02.2026 15:00 (to Station in charge, Alappuzha Lighthouse). Listing gives end 2026-02-25 and opening 2026-02-27. Blank forms issued 10.02.2026 to 25.02.2026 (10:00-16:00) at Deep Bhavan Kochi or Alappuzha Lighthouse; site inspection allowed in same period. Hindi clause 1 has a blank day ('.02.2026'). Thottappally Lighthouse is not in station list.
